## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D war game featuring Fethullah Gülen as a character.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport at most 1280px wide, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a fictional, non-graphic tactical survival game: defend a relay through three hostile waves.
- Used a stylized elder-scholar character with robe, cap, beard, glasses, and staff.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a Three.js game, HUD, title and ending overlays, arena, relay, character, hostile waves, movement, aiming, shooting, health, and touch controls in `index.html`.
- Tested the game in Playwright; WebGL canvas rendered, gameplay started, enemies spawned, and latest screenshot was inspected.

### Active
- Refine arena visuals and verify the latest changes.

### Blocked
- Last two edit attempts to add arena cover failed because the exact `oldString` did not match; the attempted code was not applied.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` around the arena/perimeter loop and add cover visuals if still desired.
2. Reload the browser, verify the arena and gameplay, and inspect a newly captured JPEG.
3. Check `git status` and report the uncommitted changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent inspected gameplay screenshot.
